name: Four Seasons Hotel Buenos Aires
insider_take: This palatial retreat in Recoleta seamlessly blends French Belle Époque elegance with contemporary Argentine sophistication, creating Buenos Aires' most coveted luxury address.
whats_special: Located in the heart of aristocratic Recoleta, this mansion-style hotel occupies a restored early 20th-century palace just steps from Eva Perón's tomb at Recoleta Cemetery. The property features Argentina's only hotel with a dedicated tango butler who can arrange private lessons with world-champion dancers, plus a rooftop pool offering panoramic views of the city's eclectic architecture.
pro_tip: Book the Mansion Suite for exclusive access to the private rooftop terrace - it's the only spot in Recoleta where you can see both the Rio de la Plata and the entire city skyline while sipping Argentine Malbec at sunset.
dont_miss: The hotel's Elena restaurant, helmed by a James Beard-nominated chef, serves elevated Argentine cuisine in a stunning glass conservatory. Also explore the nearby Floralis Genérica - a massive metal flower sculpture that opens and closes with the sun, located in Plaza de las Naciones Unidas just a 5-minute walk away.
pros: Prime location in upscale Recoleta neighborhood
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Elegant rooms with French mansion-style architecture
Outstanding dining at Elena restaurant and rooftop pool terrace
cons: Formal atmosphere may not suit all travelers
